queries.text: "Eliane Calligaris" kept as in the original; in 06-0005 the same author appears as "Elane Calligaris." Probably the psychoanalyst Eliana Calligaris; spelling not corrected because the identification is uncertain.

The original reads "Uma vez que acredite que o mesmo não verificou sua presença no local B" ("did not check ... at location B"), which contradicts the logic of the example; translated as "location A" on the evident sense. If the original was intended, read "location B."
